stories.title: Demolished Buckley pub will not be rebuilt despite store refusal

stories.title: Mancot man jailed for life for raping three children
stories.summary: A man from Mancot has been jailed for life for raping three children and sexually abusing a fourth. Daniel Bremner, 35, was sentenced at Mold Crown Court on Friday 1 May after pleading guilty to 35 offences. He must serve a minimum of 15 years before he can apply for parole. stories.title: Welsh Labour manifesto: What it says and what it means for Wales
